newsitem.title: USA: U.S spot propane flat amid lack of NYMEX direction.
newsitem.headline: U.S spot propane flat amid lack of NYMEX direction.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were flat late Thursday, with declines predicted as activity remained thin and energy futures weakened, traders said.
"There's no direction in the market," one Belvieu trader said. "There's no inordinate demand."
Crude oil for May delivery traded up-and-down but ended a mere seven cents a gallon higher at $19.42 a barrel.
Conway propane remained notionally flat at 34.25/34.75 cents.
Belvieu butane was steady at 37.25/37.50 cents, with demand lower following wintertime blending into gasoline.
